dayTitle: Grand Opening, Presidential Commission & Livestock Parade
summary: VIP reception, ribbon cutting by Hon. Minister of Livestock, Kano Durbar horsemen display, E-tagging showcase, crafted/culinary entries intake, parade floats, beer garden, karaoke night, and opening fireworks.

events.title: VIP Reception & Security
events.description: VIP Arrival, Red Carpet Reception & Security Sweep by Police, Military & Agro-Rangers.
events.speaker: Security & Protocol Directorate

events.title: Opening Parade & Ribbon Cutting by Hon. Minister of Livestock
events.description: Official opening of Livestock Pavilion & Grand Parade of prize dairy cattle, camels, and bulls.
events.speaker: Hon. Minister of Livestock Development

events.title: E-Tagging & Vet Showcase
events.description: Arena 1: RFID tracking demo. Tech Hub: Modern husbandry workshop. Open crafted, visual, culinary, needlework, and garden entries accepted.
events.speaker: Veterinary & Technical Directorate

events.title: Cultural Heritage Night & Grand Durbar
events.description: Kano Durbar Horsemen Display, Live Cultural Troupes, Animal Costume Parade Floats, Beer Garden Entertainment, Karaoke Night, and Opening Fireworks.
events.speaker: Cultural Heritage Directorate

dayTitle: Agro-Investment Summit, Pastoralist Forum & Concert Night 1
summary: Concurrent forums, Queen/King of NLC Pageant, live auction, cattle formation & sheep/goat judging, Pastoralist Forum with MACBAN/Kautal Hore, Jr./Sr. Does dairy goat shows, parade floats, and live concert.

events.title: Concurrent Forums & Queen/King NLC Pageant
events.venue: Marquee 1, Hall B, Event Tent & Youth Arena
events.description: Marquee 1: Investors Roundtable. Hall B: Agropreneur Financing Workshop. Youth Rabbit Show Check-In. Youth Arena: Queen and King of National Livestock Carnival (NLC) Pageant.
events.speaker: Agribusiness & Capital Directorate

events.title: Live Auction, Tech Fair & Breed Competitions
events.venue: Auction Arena, Exhibition Marquee & Show Rings
events.description: Auction Arena: Livestock Auction with RFID bidding. Exhibition: Meat/Dairy Tech. Cattle Formation Judging. Sheep and Goat Breed Competition.
events.speaker: National Breed Judges Panel

events.title: Pastoralist Forum & Specialized Goat Shows
events.venue: Conference Hall A & Goat Show Rings
events.description: MACBAN & Kautal Hore Dialogue, Regional Cooperative Harmonization & Awards. Youth Dairy & Meat Breeding Goat Check-In, Dairy Goat Shows Jr./Sr. Does, Goat Showmanship, Youth Market & Meat Goat Shows.
events.speaker: MACBAN & Kautal Hore Leadership

events.title: Agritainment & Live Concert Night 1
events.venue: Central Track, Gala Pavilion & Mainstage Arena
events.description: Parade Floats (Animal Costumes), Executive Gala Dinner, Stand-Up Comedy, and Headlining Concert featuring Top Nigerian Artist #1.
events.speaker: Mainstage Entertainment Directorate

dayTitle: Commercial B2B Matchmaking, Breed Awards & Grand Finale Concert
summary: Commercial B2B Matchmaking, High Stakes Auction, Children's Workshop, Dog/Cat shows, Quilt judging, Breed Champions Awards, closing press conference, and Grand Finale Concert with Top Nigerian Artist #2.

events.title: Commercial B2B Matchmaking & Pet/Home Arts Shows
events.venue: B2B Marquee, Auction Ring, Event Tent & Children's Pavilion
events.description: Commercial B2B Matchmaking, B2B Supplier Meet, High Stakes Auction, Children's Workshop, Open Crafted/Visual/Home Arts judging, Dog Show & Showmanship, Cat Show Check-in & Showmanship, Quilt Judging (Open to Public).
events.speaker: B2B Trade Secretariat

events.title: Livestock Judging Awards & Trophy Presentation
events.description: Livestock Judging Awards at Beef Show Ring, Exhibitor Recognition, Breed Champions Awards, Pastoralist Cooperative Grants & Trophy Presentation.
events.speaker: Grand Championship Directorate

events.title: Closing Press Conference
events.description: Communique Readout by Steering Committee & Media Q&A Session.
events.speaker: Steering Committee & Ministerial Press Team

events.title: Grand Finale Concert & Laser Light Show
events.description: Official Closing Remarks & Patrons Recognition, Grand Finale Concert featuring superstar Top Nigerian Artist #2, Laser Light Show & Fireworks Display, and Commercial Bazaar.
events.speaker: Festival Executive Directorate
